statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Nvidia-led premarket strength is broadening, but persistent no-retracement NQ structure is not verified.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH; the main conditional risk concentration is the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster through the cash-open price-discovery window.
headline: Nvidia-led Nasdaq futures strengthen before U.S. data
body: Reuters reported Nasdaq-100 futures about 1.0% higher and NVIDIA about 7.4% higher premarket. VIX was near 15, the U.S. 10-year yield was lower and oil extended its decline, while a fresh report of possible semiconductor tariffs added policy uncertainty. The evidence supports WATCH, not a block.

lookbackSummary: Tail was low through Wednesday's pre-earnings session, rose to WATCH during NVIDIA's delayed earnings-call reversal and overnight follow-through, then eased before returning to WATCH at 09:00 UTC as Nvidia-led premarket strength broadened. The 06:00 UTC Thursday slot is unavailable.
outlookSummary: Current Tail remains in WATCH because Nvidia-led premarket strength is substantial but a persistent no-retracement NQ path is not verified. Conditional risk is concentrated around the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster and cash open, with Marvell's 20:45 UTC call a secondary semiconductor checkpoint.

forecast.analysis: If the premarket advance broadens while pullbacks remain shallow, Tail could stay in WATCH into the data window; a loss of breadth or deeper retracement would argue against one-way structure.

The 12:30 UTC claims and advance trade/inventory releases create a high-stress checkpoint. A two-way reaction would favor whipsaw; repeated extension after failed pullbacks would be the key Tail amplifier.

Post-data price discovery into the 13:30 UTC cash open is the strongest conditional risk hour. Sustained directional efficiency across NQ and technology breadth would bring Tail close to the block threshold.
The first cash hour is the critical path test. Opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks would keep Tail near 24%; meaningful retracement and breadth normalization would reduce the risk.
After the opening impulse, Tail should ease if two-way trade returns. Persistent session-extreme holding with aligned semiconductor participation would keep WATCH conditions elevated.
If opening volatility decays and retracements deepen, risk should normalize toward mixed trade; continued directional efficiency would keep residual WATCH conditions in place.
Late-morning structure is expected to be less event-driven. Tail falls below WATCH if breadth and price action become two-way rather than maintaining session-extreme pressure.
Mid-session risk is lower absent fresh catalysts. Persistent one-way structure would require renewed confirmation from NQ, semiconductors and cross-assets rather than the morning gap alone.
Power-hour sensitivity rises with Marvell results approaching after the close. Tail remains conditional on whether the cash session is already showing efficient directional persistence.

Marvell's scheduled post-close results and 20:45 UTC conference call create a semiconductor catalyst window. Large headline moves primarily raise Stress unless index-level one-way continuation is verified.
During the Marvell call, delayed semiconductor repricing is the main conditional risk. Tail remains in WATCH unless NQ develops sustained extension with weak or failed retracements.
Post-call trading may remain choppy. A fading reaction would lower Tail, while a second directional leg across major AI names would preserve WATCH conditions.
As event liquidity thins, Tail falls below WATCH if the semiconductor reaction becomes contained and two-way. Residual gap risk remains higher than a normal overnight baseline.
Overnight conditions should normalize if no new catalyst appears. Persistent continuation would need fresh price-path confirmation rather than extrapolation from the U.S. close.
Early Asia trading carries modest residual technology risk. Tail stays low if regional tech participation is balanced and NQ retraces normally.
With the earnings catalyst aging, the base case is lower event stress. Any renewed one-way move would require independent overnight NQ evidence.
The quiet overnight window has low scheduled U.S. catalyst risk. Cross-asset stability would reinforce a normal regime.
Pre-Europe conditions remain low stress unless a geopolitical or policy headline reactivates oil, yields or semiconductor risk.
European open can reintroduce cross-market direction. Tail remains low unless technology breadth and NQ both extend without meaningful retracement.
European price discovery may increase two-way volatility. Persistent U.S. futures direction would need confirmation from yields and semiconductors to lift Tail.
As U.S. premarket depth returns, attention shifts toward Friday's Jackson Hole speech. Stress can rise on positioning even without a pathological price path.
Closer to the U.S. premarket, Tail returns to WATCH on event sensitivity. A balanced tape would keep the risk at the lower edge of WATCH.
Friday premarket risk rises ahead of the 14:00 UTC Jackson Hole keynote. Tail remains conditional on observed price efficiency; event importance alone does not imply a block.
